QuestInfo.name: A Fragment in the Forest
QuestInfo.0: Putting yourself in the perpetrator's shoes, you get the feeling that they might have decided to hide out in the forest. Ellinia Forest is Victoria Island's largest forest, so head there and see if you can find anything out of place.
QuestInfo.1: Putting yourself in the perpetrator's shoes, you get the feeling that they might have decided to hide out in the forest. Ellinia Forest is Victoria Island's largest forest, so you decide to head there and see what you might turn up. There, you meet a nosy cat whose behavior was more than a little suspicious. The cat introduces itself as Fanzy, and tells you that two strange people showed up recently, argued with one another, then threw a small fragment of some sort down into the forest. It looks like you'll have to go there to see if you can find whatever it was they threw.
QuestInfo.2: Putting yourself in the perpetrator's shoes, you got the feeling that they might have decided to hide out in the forest. Ellinia Forest is Victoria Island's largest forest, so you decided to head there and see what you might turn up. There, you met a nosy cat whose behavior was more than a little suspicious. The cat introduced itself as Fanzy, and told you that two strange people showed up recently, argued with one another, then threw a small fragment of some sort down into the forest. You ventured into the forest in search of whatever they had thrown in, and it turned out to be another fragment of the Core.
